'''Johzan B'oh''' was a [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] and compulsive [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]]. B'oh could usually be found at an establishment known as [[Ace of Sabres|Ace of Sabers]].<ref name="Alien Anthology">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
